idea-plugin.name: Lattency
idea-plugin.description:
See where Java code leaves the process.

Lattency adds gutter markers for database, HTTP, messaging, and file I/O. It follows calls through project code, so you can see whether a method eventually leaves the process without walking the call chain by hand.

  • Distinct icons for database, HTTP, messaging, file, and generic I/O.
  • Dimmed icons distinguish transitive I/O from direct I/O.
  • Tooltips explain the complete sink chain, with click-through navigation.
  • Zero configuration for common Java and Spring APIs, including Spring Data, JDBC, REST clients, Kafka, Pub/Sub, JMS, RabbitMQ, and file APIs.
  • A committed lattency.yml can add project-specific sinks, exclusions, and a custom propagation depth.

Private by design: the analysis is entirely static. Lattency does not run your application, make network requests, or collect telemetry.

Requires IntelliJ IDEA 2025.2 or newer. Java only; Kotlin is not supported.
